question.text: Identify the incorrect statement among the following

options.text: $\mathrm{d-}$ Block elements show irregular and erratic chemical properties among themselves
$\mathrm{La}$ and $\mathrm{Lu}$ have partially filled $d$ orbitals and no other partially filled orbitals
The chemistry of various lanthanoids is very similar
$4 f$ and $5 f$ orbitals are equally shielded

solution.text:
$4 \mathrm{f}$ and $5 \mathrm{f}$ belongs to different energy levels, hence the shielding effect is on them is not the same. 
Shielding of $4 \mathrm{f}$ is more than $5 \mathrm{f}$.
Hence (D) is correct.
